title: Earlier hierarchy cost boundary; uniform target compiler now supplied
statement: CURRENT STATUS: This is a valid limitation of the earlier32-per-layer quadratic hierarchy and algebraic graph. The NEW P2 005BCF shear-return-loop/two-stage construction supplies the FULL uniform variable-target exact12-force polynomial compiler under its accepted erasure premise. The older route is still insufficient,but the corresponding physical endpoint is no longer open in the supplied current theorem. HISTORICAL ROUTE STATEMENT: The completed zero-target12-mode theorem has fixed precomputed depthD and H_D=K^[(32^(D+1)-1)/31]rho^[160*32^D],so p=256*32^(D+1) is a legitimate FIXED exponent there. For a target catalogue of radiusN,one quadratic generation step at most doubles the previous radius. Starting at unit modes needs D>=log_2 N up to fixed initial radii. The SAME hierarchy therefore gives an exponent growing at least likeN^5,before support-dependentK is paid. It does not yield one uniform polynomial in variable target input/numerical size. This is a demonstrated implementation-cost obstruction,not a lower bound for all admitted12-mode controls or a failure of algebraic saturation. The separate growing-catalogue common-target construction is already positive; a new efficient fixed-catalogue physical synthesis would require its own mechanism.

Fixed accepted enlarged-family macro-word/Sobolev construction and effective rational signed-quadratic saturation to fixed depth D are premises. Unknown initial H1 ball, all small L-infinity L2 disturbances and EVERY Leray-Hopf realization remain simultaneous. Physical forcing may use all transverse modes of radius<=2N,N=ceil(16M/epsilon). No strong final-ramp trajectory, terminal H1 smallness, feedback or initial-state-dependent control is assumed.
